name: Chapter Route - Longest Chapter Name Wraps
description: Seattle / Pacific Northwest is the longest name on the roster, so this pins that both the hero title and the band heading (Seattle / Pacific Northwest meets online for now.) wrap cleanly instead of clipping. It is also the real forming (WhatsApp-only) chapter page: the hero with the Online group kicker, then the three buttons Request to join WhatsApp, Subscribe to newsletter and Volunteer or co-lead, then straight to the footer. No events, write-up, sign-up band, global-community band or Connect with us.
